<!-- Feel free to remove any irrelevant sections -->

**Operating System**
OS version; for Linux, also distribution, desktop environment and Wayland/X11.

Attach relevant OpenSCL4 logs after reviewing them for private information. For Bluetooth captures, read https://github.com/SckraT/OpenSCL4/blob/master/docs/capture-bluetooth-logs.md before sharing.

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
